The model binary is redistributed unchanged. The runtime is bundled from the
original TypeScript source without algorithm changes. Source is available at
licenses/extra-trees.ts. The model and its runtime, including any adaptations,
remain under CC BY-SA 4.0. No endorsement by the original author is implied.
Application-specific audio gating, streaming, Korean labels, and abstention
rules are additions. The model is experimental and has no untouched compatible
final holdout. It is not suitable for diagnosis, infant safety monitoring, or
caregiving decisions. No training audio is distributed with this application.
